settings.ceo_bio:
DADO is more than porcelain stoneware — it is a combination of quality, design and trust. We approach every product with a focus on long-term value.

Our goal is to offer our customers not only beautiful, but also reliable and contemporary solutions. We continue to develop DADO with a strong commitment to quality and responsibility.
settings.ceo_bio_uz:
DADO — bu shunchaki keramogranit emas, bu sifat, dizayn va ishonch uyg‘unligidir. Biz har bir mahsulotga uzoq muddatli qiymat yaratish nuqtayi nazaridan yondashamiz.

Maqsadimiz — mijozlarimizga nafaqat chiroyli, balki ishonchli va zamonaviy yechimlarni taqdim etish. Biz DADO brendini sifat va mas’uliyat bilan rivojlantirishda davom etamiz.
settings.ceo_bio_ru:
DADO — это не просто керамогранит, а сочетание качества, дизайна и доверия. Мы подходим к каждому продукту с пониманием его долгосрочной ценности.

Наша цель — предлагать клиентам не только красивые, но и надёжные современные решения. Мы продолжаем развивать DADO, сохраняя высокие требования к качеству и ответственности.
settings.ceo_bio_en:
DADO is more than porcelain stoneware — it is a combination of quality, design and trust. We approach every product with a focus on long-term value.

Our goal is to offer our customers not only beautiful, but also reliable and contemporary solutions. We continue to develop DADO with a strong commitment to quality and responsibility.
settings.footer_text: Dado is more than one factory. Four distinct characters, one standard of quality and style.
settings.footer_text_uz: Dado — bu bitta zavod emas. Bu to‘rt xil xarakter, yagona sifat va uslub.
settings.footer_text_ru: Dado — это не один завод. Это четыре разных характера, единое качество и стиль.
settings.footer_text_en: Dado is more than one factory. Four distinct characters, one standard of quality and style.

brand.name: Dado Mosaic
brand.hero_subtitle: A premium glass mosaic collection designed for hospitality.
brand.about_text:
The DADO MOSAIC collection is designed for hotel lobbies, restaurants, spas and bathrooms. Each 300×300 mm sheet is assembled from glossy, textured and convex gold elements.

The collection’s strengths: a hotel collection, premium quality, water resistance, luxury design and eco-friendly materials. The mosaic is used on walls, in pools and on accent surfaces.

product.description: Premium glass mosaic, 300×300 mm sheet. Glossy and textured gold elements for walls, pools and accent surfaces.
